architectVerdict: Merge-ready (fable judge, 2026-09-01). All four singleSeams hold as one implementation each: the schema vendor pair is byte-identical whole-file; phaseOwnPatterns and detectInstaller have provably single homes with all consumers routed through them; the one new worktree-porcelain parse (executor-arm worktreeRoots) answers a question the classifier structurally cannot (it needs the primary and slots surveyLanes excludes) and forks no classification logic. All four honesty rails mechanically in force: measure assert green at 13,256/13,257; the new accounting paths contain zero removal calls (report-only proven by grep and pinned by test); every spot-checked refusal names reason + runnable remedy; tolerance-never-silent holds for D1/D2/D4/D5 with the D3 carve-out now recorded at arc level. The design-gate skip survived the build — every new surface is a mechanical extension of a named existing rail. POLYSEAT's designRefs remain true: drivers.mjs has zero diff, launch still routes through the registry, and both the protocol-parity and envelope-overhead ratchets are green (envelope measured 3,831/16,710 = 0.2293 against 0.235). Every model-loaded-prose trim carries its DIET-LEDGER row with live code-side enforcement. Findings: three LOWs, zero blockers — none gates the merge.
